text:
Maia (PM): Heads-up: we want to swap to the quantized v2 runtime for text-generation in US/EU regions next week. Need a rollout plan + A/B to validate latency/cost vs quality. Customers NovaHealth and FinEdge want early visibility.
Jun (Eng-ML): TL;DR: quant-v2 cuts token cost ~35% and p95 latency ~15% but may slightly change outputs on long prompts. We should gate by a quiet quality check + infra metrics.
Priya (Eng-Platform): Proposed flow: feature flag rollout.quantized.swap -> region pinned canaries (us-west, eu-central) -> cohort A/B inside canary (50/50) -> expand to tenant opt-ins -> public ramp with progressive pct 5->20->50.
Leo (SRE): Add infra gates: p95 < baseline_p95 * 1.1 AND cpu/gpu util per node < 85% AND error_rate < 0.3% for 20m. Also p99 must not regress > 200ms.
Ivy (Customer Success): NovaHealth wants to be in the first tenant opt-in. FinEdge is ok for 10% beta. We'll coordinate comms.
Maia (PM): Quality gates: sample 0.2% of requests for auto-eval against canonical prompt set (200 prompts). Fail if average F1/ROUGE drops > 3% OR hallucination rate up >2% in 30m window. Also run manual spot-check on sampled outputs.
Jun (Eng-ML): We can add eval pipeline: sidecar collects outputs, compares to baseline model outputs offline, and emits quality.delta. Will need storage for sampled outputs.
Priya (Eng-Platform): Flag rules draft:
```yaml
flag: rollout.quantized.swap
rules:
  - name: regional-canary-us
    regions: [us-west]
    pct: 5
  - name: regional-canary-eu
    regions: [eu-central]
    pct: 5
  - name: tenant-optins
    tenants: ["novahealth", "finedge"]
    pct: 10
  - name: public-gradual
    pct: 20
abort_triggers:
  - infra.p95 > baseline.p95 * 1.1 for 20m
  - infra.error_rate > 0.3% for 10m
  - eval.quality_drop > 3% for 30m

kill_action: disable-flag-immediate
```
Maia (PM): UX experiment: inside canary do A/B where A=baseline runtime, B=quant-v2. Log exp_id=quant-swap-202606 and include header X-Exp: quant-swap so we can link traces.
Jun (Eng-ML): Also track semantic drift metric: embedding cosine similarity on sampled completions vs baseline; threshold < 0.92 triggers a hard stop.
Leo (SRE): Operational constraints: quantized path increases CPU on host (dequantization). Add a per-region traffic cap: 120rps fallback burst and per-tenant soft cap = 40rps. Add circuit-breaker that reverts traffic to baseline if backend errors > 1% in 5m.
Priya (Eng-Platform): We'll implement deterministic A/B by user_id hash and ensure sticky assignment for 24h. Canary traffic will be tagged in logs: route.quant=quant-v2 or route.quant=baseline.
Ivy (Customer Success): I'll draft emails for NovaHealth and FinEdge with rollback expectations and how to opt-out.
Maia (PM): Owners: Jun -> quality eval pipeline + model vetting, Priya -> flag + automation + A/B infra, Leo -> alerts + circuit-breaker + SLOs, Ivy -> customer comms.
Priya (Eng-Platform): I'll open the PR and auto-rollout job. Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/flags/pulls/489 (WIP). Deploy-bot will announce each stage.
deploy-bot: Job queued: rollout.quantized.swap v2 -> staging at 2067890560 (triggered by Priya).
Leo (SRE): Alerting channels: pager (oncall-bot), slack #incidents, and a rollback channel #quant-swap-rollbacks. Pager threshold: only if customer impact > 0.5% of overall TPS or sustained errors.
Jun (Eng-ML): Data capture note: keep 10k sampled outputs for 48h, encrypt at rest. We'll need storage entitlement approval.
Maia (PM): Timeline proposal: staging validation today, regional canaries tomorrow morning, tenant opt-ins tomorrow afternoon, public ramp Friday morning if green. Go/no-go checkpoints 30m before each step.
Ivy (Customer Success): NovaHealth confirmed readiness for tomorrow afternoon. FinEdge asks for explicit opt-out mechanism (UI toggle).
Priya (Eng-Platform): We'll expose a per-tenant toggle in the tenant console for opt-out. Also create a quick revert runbook.
Jun (Eng-ML): Experiment success criteria: cost per 1M tokens reduced by >=25% AND quality delta within thresholds AND user-facing complaints not above baseline x2 within 24h.
Leo (SRE): Checklist before canary: health endpoints for quant path, dashboard tile for quant vs baseline latencies, burn-in @ 200rps for 3m, and circuit-breaker smoke test.
Maia (PM): Action items: Priya -> PR + flag, Jun -> eval pipeline + drift checks, Leo -> alerts + dashboard + runbook, Ivy -> customer comms + opt-out docs. I'll coordinate and post go/no-go updates.
Priya (Eng-Platform): Noted. I'll tag each commit with exp=quant-swap-202606.
oncall-bot: Acknowledged. Oncall team standing by.
Ivy (Customer Success): I'll schedule 1:1 with NovaHealth to walk through expectations.
Maia (PM): Thanks all. We'll reconvene after staging validation. Closing thread for now.
